pendingApprovalDescription: Items used on completed jobs — Filter Change visits marked Completed (or given an Acc D), installs given an Installed Date, repair parts, and schedule jobs' recorded filters — wait here for admin approval. Map anything not yet matched to a stock item, change an item or quantity if something different was used, then approve; nothing changes in inventory until approved, and rejecting leaves stock alone.

approveAllPendingSkipped: {count} item(s) not yet mapped to a stock item will be skipped — map them in Pending Inventory Approval.
approveAllPendingNoneMapped: All {count} pending item(s) still need to be mapped to a stock item before they can be approved.

approveAllNeedsMapping: Pending items need a stock item mapped first (Pending Inventory Approval)
reviewQueueHint: Review pending items: map items to stock, change quantities, approve or reject
nothingPendingApproval: Nothing is waiting on inventory approval right now.
